info.name: TireMax API v1
info.description:
Complete API collection for the TireMax mobile/web application. All authenticated routes require a Bearer token obtained from login or register.

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}/api/v1`

**Auth:** JWT Bearer token — pass as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`

**Quick Start:**
1. Set `base_url` variable (e.g. `http://localhost:8000`)
2. Run **Login** — the test script auto-saves the token
3. All authenticated requests pick it up automatically

variable.description: JWT access token — set after login/register

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, token refresh, profile management and logout.

request.description:
Create a new customer account.

**Body params:**
- `name` *(required, string, max:120)* — Full name
- `phone` *(required, string, max:20, unique)* — Phone number (used as login identifier)
- `email` *(optional, email, max:120, unique)* — Email address
- `password` *(required, string, min:6)* — Password
- `password_confirmation` *(required, string)* — Must match `password`
- `address` *(optional, string, max:255)* — Default text address
- `locale` *(optional, enum: en|ar)* — Preferred language

response.name: 422 Validation Error

request.description:
Authenticate with phone number or email.

**Body params:**
- `login` *(required, string)* — Phone number **or** email address
- `password` *(required, string)* — Account password

> The test script automatically saves the returned token to the `token` collection variable.

Issue a new access token using the current (possibly near-expiry) token. No body required — old token read from `Authorization` header.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Return the authenticated customer's profile.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Update the authenticated customer's profile. All fields are optional (PATCH semantics via PUT).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body params (all optional):**
- `name` *(string, max:120)* — Full name
- `email` *(email, max:120, unique)* — Email address (pass `null` to unset)
- `address` *(string, max:255)* — Default text address
- `locale` *(enum: en|ar)* — Preferred language
- `password` *(string, min:6)* — New password
- `password_confirmation` *(string)* — Must match `password`

response.name: 200 OK
422 Validation Error

request.description:
Invalidate the current JWT token.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**No body required.**

item.name: Home
item.description: Homepage aggregated data — featured products, best sellers, new arrivals, offers, brands, governorates.

request.description:
Returns aggregated home screen data in a single call. No auth required.

**Response sections:**
- `featured` — up to 12 featured products (sort_order asc)
- `best_sellers` — up to 8 products with BEST_SELLER badge
- `new_arrivals` — up to 8 products with NEW badge (latest first)
- `offers` — up to 8 products that have a sale price set
- `brands` — all active brands (sort_order asc)
- `governorates` — all active governorates (sort_order asc)

response.name: 200 OK

item.name: Products
item.description: Browse, search and filter the product catalog. Auth is optional — when authenticated the `is_favorited` flag is populated per product.

query.description: Full-text search by product name or SKU

request.description:
Paginated product listing with search and filters. Auth optional.

**Query params (all optional):**
- `page` — Page number
- `per_page` — Items per page
- `search` — Full-text search on name / SKU
- `brand_id` — Filter by brand
- `category_id` — Filter by category
- `min_price` / `max_price` — Price range filter
- `sort` — Sort order: `price_asc`, `price_desc`, `newest`, `name_asc`

Get full product details including specs. Also tracks a view event (customer ID if auth, IP, user-agent).

**URL params:**
- `product` *(integer)* — Product ID

**Response includes:** brand, category, images, badges, `tireSpec` (width, aspect_ratio, rim_diameter, load_index, speed_rating), `batterySpec` (voltage, capacity, cca)

item.name: Reviews
item.description: Product reviews — public read, authenticated write.

request.description:
Returns approved customer reviews for a product (paginated). Also returns aggregate rating statistics in meta.

**URL params:**
- `product` *(integer)* — Product ID

**Response meta:** `rating_avg` (float), `rating_count` (integer), `pagination`

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Submit a customer review for a product. Review is stored with `is_approved: false` and requires admin approval before it appears publicly.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL params:**
- `product` *(integer)* — Product ID

**Body params:**
- `rating` *(required, integer, 1–5)* — Star rating
- `comment` *(optional, string, max:1000)* — Review text

response.name: 201 Created (pending approval)

item.name: Cart
item.description: Shopping cart management. All endpoints require authentication.

request.description:
Returns the current user's cart with all items, product thumbnails, subtotal, discount, and total.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Add a product to the cart. If the product already exists, quantity is incremented.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body params:**
- `product_id` *(required, integer, exists:products)* — Product to add
- `quantity` *(required, integer, 1–99)* — Number of units

Update the quantity of a specific cart item. Setting `quantity` to `0` removes the item.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL params:**
- `item` *(integer)* — Cart item ID

**Body params:**
- `quantity` *(required, integer, 0–99)* — New quantity (0 removes the item)

Remove a single item from the cart.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL params:**
- `item` *(integer)* — Cart item ID

Remove all items from the cart at once.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Apply a promo/offer code to the current cart. Returns the calculated discount and new totals. **Does NOT persist** — pass the returned `discount` value when placing the order.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body params:**
- `code` *(required, string)* — Promo code

item.name: Orders
item.description:
Checkout and order lifecycle management.

**Order statuses:** `pending` → `confirmed` → `processing` → `shipped` → `delivered` → `completed` | `cancelled` | `refunded`

**Order types:** `basra` (in-store pickup) | `delivery` (home delivery)

**Payment methods:** `cod` (cash on delivery) | `bank_transfer` | `paymob` (online card)

query.description: Filter by status: pending | confirmed | processing | shipped | delivered | completed | cancelled | refunded

request.description:
Returns the authenticated customer's orders (paginated).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Query params:**
- `page` — Page number
- `status` — Filter by order status

request.description:
Convert the current cart into an order. Cart is cleared on success.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body params:**
- `type` *(required, enum: basra|delivery)* — Fulfillment type: `basra` = in-store pickup, `delivery` = home delivery
- `branch_id` *(required if type=basra, integer, exists:branches)* — Pickup branch ID
- `governorate_id` *(required if type=delivery, integer, exists:governorates)* — Delivery governorate ID
- `payment_method` *(optional, enum: cod|bank_transfer|paymob, default: cod)* — Payment method
- `customer_name` *(optional, string, max:120)* — Override customer name on the order
- `customer_phone` *(optional, string, max:20)* — Delivery contact phone
- `customer_email` *(optional, email, max:120)* — Delivery contact email
- `shipping_address` *(required if type=delivery, string, max:255)* — Full delivery address
- `notes` *(optional, string, max:500)* — Special instructions
- `discount` *(optional, numeric, min:0)* — Discount amount from promo code (use value from /cart/apply-offer)
- `installation_fee` *(optional, numeric, min:0)* — Tyre fitting / installation fee

Webhook endpoint called by Paymob servers after a payment attempt. **Do not call manually** — it is triggered by Paymob. No bearer auth (server-side IP whitelist). Returns the resulting payment status.

**Body params:**
- `full_name` *(required, string, max:255)* — Recipient full name
- `phone` *(required, string, max:20)* — Delivery contact phone
- `governorate_id` *(required, integer, exists:governorates)* — Governorate ID
- `city_id` *(required, integer, exists:cities)* — City ID (must belong to the governorate)
- `address` *(required, string, max:500)* — Street / building / landmark
- `is_default` *(optional, boolean)* — Mark as default address

response.name: 201 Created

request.description:

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

- `full_name` *(string, max:255)*
- `phone` *(string, max:20)*

request.description:
Returns all notifications for the authenticated customer (paginated, latest first).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Returns the count of unread notifications. Use for badge counters on the notification icon.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Mark a single notification as read (sets `read_at` to current timestamp).

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**URL params:**
- `id` *(string UUID)* — Notification ID

**No body required.**

Mark all unread notifications as read in one call.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**No body required.**
